english.notes:
In section 188, 'relevant document' means -
(a) an exemption certificate issued under section 166, 169 or 171;
(b) a notice of a kind mentioned in section 166(3)(b), 169(4)(b) or 171(3)(b);
(c) an accessibility certificate (see section 176);
(d) an approval certificate (see section 177)

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and or a fine.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
